launcher.release_notes:
cx-labs-launcher: use deploy key instead of PAT for manifest push (#201)

Replaces MANIFEST_REPO_PAT with MANIFEST_DEPLOY_KEY, an SSH deploy key scoped to adampikulik/cx-labs-manifest with write access only.

The PAT was a user-scoped credential with far broader reach than this one push needs. Part of the GitHub secret rotation following the 2026-08-27 incident.

No change to what the workflow produces - same manifest.json, same commit, same push.
